What a speculative decoder gives away for free

Three research records, published as they stood at their pinned commits. The central question came back negative at the registered reader, with one label space open. What holds is narrow, exact and checkable to the byte: every number on these pages drawn from the public record carries the file, the line and the digest it came from.

How to read these pages

The three records
sideband asked whether the stream of memory addresses that weight serving hardware sees for free could help a speculative decoder guess better. amber asked whether a draft model's corrections make a byte exact archive of a larger model's text. lockstep built a pure integer coder, which amber carries as an option, and proposed the container such an archive would need.
Speculative decoding
A small draft model proposes several tokens at once; the large target model checks them in one pass. Accepted tokens are emitted, the first rejected one is replaced by a draw from the target's own corrected distribution, so the output is distributed exactly as the target alone would produce. A better guesser buys speed and never changes what can come out.
A finding (F-N)
One numbered entry in a record's findings log, written when the result landed and never rewritten afterwards. A correction is added beside it with a date. In sideband, each finding names the conditions it was measured under and the committed files its numbers come from.
A kill criterion (K-N)
A way the idea could fail, written down before the data existed, and where a size of effect applied, that size fixed before the run it governed. FIRED means the record met that failure; "did not fire" means it did not; UNTESTED means no run ever tested it.
The free baseline
Everything the decoder already knows at the moment it drafts: the target's own next token probabilities, its top candidates and its internal state at the last verified position. A signal in the stream only counts if it adds to that. The first reads used a partial version of this baseline; the deciding read used the full one.
Intervals
Every value drawn with a line through it is a point estimate with a 95% bootstrap interval. The bootstrap resamples whole prompts, not tokens, so the many positions inside one prompt are not counted as independent evidence.
S1 and S3
The two places the stream was read. S1: on a dense Llama model, the slots of the units each tapped layer activated most strongly, which needs the activation values to rank them, so it is not a pure address stream. S3: on a mixture of experts model (OLMoE), which experts each token was routed to, a pure address stream with no values in it.
L1, L2, L3
The three label spaces the probes predict. L1 is sixteen classes, fifteen coarse concept buckets and one glue class for function words; L2 is about five hundred finer concepts plus the glue class; L3 groups the fine buckets into sets that stay coherent across transitions, two of which hold most of the concepts, which is why the record calls L3 a lopsided lens.
Status words
The record's conclusion labels, in capitals: ABSORBED, SURVIVES, NOT-SHOWN, SPLIT and the rest. sideband's conclusion labels were pinned before the runs they govern, with the exceptions the record names; the rest describe what a later entry did. The glossary gives the record's definition; the plain words beside each use on this page are the page's own.
Chips
The small dotted boxes are provenance chips: the file, the line and the first twelve hex characters of that file's sha256 at the tag. Click one to open those lines in the repository at the release tag. The last section of the front page shows how to check a number against the repository.
The pages
The front page holds the verdicts, the record's own opening, the kill board, the charts, the three parts, where the work sits among prior work, and how to check a number. The findings, the errata, the limits, the modules and the glossary each have a page of their own; the bar pinned to the top of every page moves between them. Everything is also on one page, for searching and printing, linked from the foot of every page.

The plain words explanations, the section intros and the reading guide are this page's own wording, not the record's; they add no claim and carry no chip.

The question and the answer, in the record's words

The two paragraphs that open the repository's README at tag v1.0.0, quoted as written: what the three records asked, and what they found. Everything on these pages unfolds from them. The numbers they state are the record's own and carry its chips; the verdicts in the tiles above are this page's wording.

When a large language model generates text, a small draft model can propose several tokens at once and the large model, the verifier, checks them in one pass; the verifier's rejection rule keeps the output exactly its own, so a better draft buys speed and never changes a result. Something also has to fetch the large model's weights, and whatever serves them, a memory device or a tier holding a mixture-of-experts model's experts, sees which weight groups or experts each token touched, as a byproduct, without reading an activation value or a logit. sideband, the central experiment, asked whether that address stream tells the draft model anything the decoder does not already have, and whether it converts into more emitted tokens. amber asked whether the draft model's rank corrections toward target-generated text make a byte-exact archive of that text. lockstep built a pure-integer coder with conformance vectors, which amber carries as an option, and proposed the model-pinned container such an archive would need.

README.md:6–19 · c7c4f9562e72

The answers are negative or narrow. sideband tested two streams, S1, a value-aware tap on a Llama-3.1-8B target, and S3, the pure address stream of an OLMoE model's routers (both described in the next section). Its probes do find a small signal: at the pinned L1 cells, with a linear probe, the stream raises top-1 accuracy at predicting the concept bucket of the token two positions ahead by +0.0141 at S1 (the replication harvest) and +0.0147 / +0.0173 at S3 (primary / replication) over a summary of what the decoder already knows (F-15, F-17). Against the fuller free baseline the record then built (the logged summaries of the target's next-token distribution, its hashed top-32 token ids and its anchor hidden state, as this pipeline encodes them), read by the registered reader mlp256, the stream's own margin at those L1 cells is about +0.003 (F-24's words), under the +0.005 floor set in advance, and no material amount more than a scrambled block of the same size adds; at L2 the same reading holds (F-25, read under a rider amendment the record calls "a post-hoc reroute around a fired kill condition"); three stronger probe readers, run later at both sources, did not overturn the L1 result (F-28 at S3, where they also read the L3 lenses; F-29 at S1), and L3, the grouped label space, stays open at both. At S1 two registered attempts to convert the signal into emitted tokens per verify call were null against the bar set in advance (F-19, F-21), and the hidden state its reconstruction lane targeted is an exact function of the target's own next-token distribution, free information (F-23); conversion and reconstruction were never run at S3. amber's codec decodes its archives byte-exactly under an fp32 contract on one box (200 of 200 on the GPU, 24 of 24 on the CPU), and its errata pass corrected 16 of the 21 claims it checked. lockstep's byte-model coder and its conformance vectors stand; the model-backed profile was never built, and the economics behind it did not survive measurement.

README.md:21–48 · c7c4f9562e72

Seven ways it could die, written before the data

Before the data, seven ways the idea could fail were written down, and where a size of effect applied, that size was fixed before the run it governed. Two fired: K-2, the stream adds no material amount beyond what the decoder already knows at the registered reader, with one grouped label space left open, and K-3, the signal did not convert into more emitted tokens per check. K-1 did not fire; K-7 did not fire as written, while its gate health diagnostic fired and was routed to an open question. K-4, K-5 and K-6 were never tested: no decoder width sweep ran on real telemetry, nothing in the record is a benchmark harness, and the premise's economics were never reached because both conversion attempts were null. Each card shows the criterion's statement in one line, its latest status entry in the record's own words, and the findings it cites.

The numbers, drawn to scale

Each chart draws numbers the record prints, to scale. A dot is the point estimate and the line through it is the 95% interval from a bootstrap over prompt clusters. A hollow dot on a dashed line is a row the record labels as not clearing its bar. The vertical dashed lines mark zero and the bar or floor that was set in advance. The record has no wall clock or speedup figure of its own, so none is drawn here. The table view under each chart lists every row as printed, with its source line.

Arcs and findings

An arc is a stretch of the work with one question; the arcs group the findings the way the record's index does. A finding card opens to the record's first sentence, the conditions it was measured under (the regime), the evidence files it points at, and the numbers it states. The capitalised words are the record's conclusion labels; the plain words beside them are this page's. The 67 findings: 30 from sideband, 16 from amber, 21 from lockstep.

Synthetic world (F-0 .. F-9)

The first arc built the verifier and a synthetic concept-HMM testbed (tokens grouped into ground-truth concept buckets, with a tunable draft) and used it to fix the shapes that every later experiment inherits.

The full summary

The first arc built the verifier and a synthetic concept-HMM testbed (tokens grouped into ground-truth concept buckets, with a tunable draft) and used it to fix the shapes that every later experiment inherits. The verifier is exact by enumeration and at float64 epsilon under measurement (F-0, F-1), so acceptance rate is the only outcome any steering experiment can move. In this world most rejections are cross-bucket (76.1% to 89.3%, F-2), always-on bucket boosting self-cancels unless gated on disagreement (F-3), a block-held prediction ages out unless concept persistence comfortably exceeds gamma (F-4), a narrow sideband with a weak decoder is harmful ungated and harmless gated (F-5), a centered posterior bias dominates argmax boosting (F-7), and dense per-position hints lose 20:1 in a bit ledger (F-9). The structural result is F-6: steering from free information and from a stale telemetry oracle are identical curves here, so this world can never show a telemetry win and the existence question had to move to real models.

Kill-criterion outcome: none adjudicated. K-2 is provably un-adjudicable in this world (F-6); K-4 received only a shape (F-5).

The full kill criterion outcome

Kill-criterion outcome: none adjudicated. K-2 is provably un-adjudicable in this world (F-6); K-4 received only a shape (F-5). The mechanism rules from F-3, F-7 and the "free steering pays" half of F-9 were later qualified on real models (F-12, F-13).

Real Phase 0 (F-10 .. F-14)

The first GPU results ran a Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct NF4 target with a Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct bf16 draft over 210 committed prompts (F-10).

The full summary

The first GPU results ran a Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct NF4 target with a Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct bf16 draft over 210 committed prompts (F-10). Rejections are overwhelmingly bucket-level (residual mass 0.778 to 0.863 by k, F-10), and after glue buckets are excluded by the pre-registered K-7 rule the majority are still concept-to-concept jumps (0.565 to 0.674 by k, F-11), so the addressable share of failures is real. Free-information bucket-bias steering, however, never beats vanilla and is harmful at the confirmatory setting (-0.0098 [-0.0155, -0.0039], F-12); the diagnosis is a gate that is open about 94% of the time over 510 fine buckets and a bucket persistence of 0.027 that makes any block-held prediction stale by construction. Coarsening the gating space restores the gate's selectivity but every arm still loses (F-13), and a perfect non-causal forecast at coarse k converts to at most +0.0069 acceptance through this actuator (F-14).

Kill-criterion outcome: K-1 (rejections not cross-bucket) did not fire (F-10); K-7 (glue tax cannot be neutralized) did not fire as written (F-11).

The full kill criterion outcome

Kill-criterion outcome: K-1 (rejections not cross-bucket) did not fire (F-10); K-7 (glue tax cannot be neutralized) did not fire as written (F-11). The free-information actuator was killed as built (F-12, F-13, F-14), which set the D-5 free baseline at zero on real models and blocked Phase 4 until a different actuator existed; no K-3 verdict was reached here.

Existence probes (F-15 .. F-18)

Phase 3 asked kill criterion K-2's question directly: do probes on free summaries plus telemetry beat probes on free summaries alone at offsets >= 2?

The full summary

Phase 3 asked kill criterion K-2's question directly: do probes on free summaries plus telemetry beat probes on free summaries alone at offsets >= 2? At S1 (weight-slot occupancy taps on the Llama target) the pinned replication triple re-fired at +0.0141 [+0.0081, +0.0203] and all eight offset-2/offset-3 triples re-fired, while free information dies by offset 3 and offset 4 is not established (F-15). At S3 (OLMoE router expert ids, a pure address stream) the pinned gate re-fired at +0.0173 [+0.0133, +0.0221] with the entire firing set reproducing cell-for-cell (F-17). Two registered post-hoc diagnostics then tested the cheapest software substitute, concept histograms of the already generated prefix: at both sources it predicts about nothing and the telemetry margin passes an equal-dimension alignment-destroyed noise control (F-16, F-18), with one honest qualifier that about a tenth of S3's coarse-group margin is genuinely topic-shaped.

Kill-criterion outcome: K-2 survived at S1 (F-15) and at S3 (F-17), both on pinned fresh-seed replications, against the 657-summary PROXY; S2 (KV pages) was never run.

Conversion attempt 1 (F-19)

K-3 Attempt #1 froze the S1 probes and used them to decide, per block, when to stop drafting early or extend the block, comparing five arms at matched drafting budget on 210 fresh prompts with emitted tokens per verify call as the estimand.

The full summary

K-3 Attempt #1 froze the S1 probes and used them to decide, per block, when to stop drafting early or extend the block, comparing five arms at matched drafting budget on 210 fresh prompts with emitted tokens per verify call as the estimand. The telemetry arm landed at +0.006860 [-0.015024, +0.025572] over vanilla against a registered bar of +0.062, and a val-tuned advantage of +0.060 shrank to +0.007 on fresh prompts (F-19). The pairwise budget guard was breached twice by a real mechanism (the extend channel inflates budget on harder prompts), and an information-free gamma-6 control showed raw tokens per call is buyable without information, which is why matched budget was load-bearing.

Kill-criterion outcome: K-3 fired exactly as registered. Per the dated fold-back count amendment this opened a two-lane fold-back (OQ-15, then OQ-16, hard stop after the second); …

Fold-back #1 (F-20, F-21)

OQ-15 trained ridge heads to predict per-position analytic acceptance from the K-3 byproduct logs. The Stage I existence gate passed mechanically at delta_noise +0.000763 [+0.000308, +0.001215], but a five-seed stale-target control (targets replaced by within-prompt permutations, so no block-aligned information exists for any …

The full summary

OQ-15 trained ridge heads to predict per-position analytic acceptance from the K-3 byproduct logs. The Stage I existence gate passed mechanically at delta_noise +0.000763 [+0.000308, +0.001215], but a five-seed stale-target control (targets replaced by within-prompt permutations, so no block-aligned information exists for any head) produced margins of the same magnitude and spread, and the free-features head beat the telemetry head outright (delta_free -0.00286 [-0.00322, -0.00252]); the pinned label is ARTIFACT-DOMINANT and the registered meaning of the pass is removed (F-20). Stage C then drove live stop/extend decisions from the frozen heads on 210 fresh prompts: the telemetry head tied vanilla (+0.002664 [-0.044719, +0.046727]) and lost CI-clear to the same policy on free features (-0.081846 [-0.132484, -0.035567]), the live mirror of F-20's delta_free (F-21). A seed-2 budget-guard breach was traced to a selection-time gap between arms, fixed by a registered re-freeze, and the seed-3 rerun cleared the guard on every leg.

Kill-criterion outcome: by the pinned partition, Stage I PASSED plus Stage C NOT-WIN equals CONVERSION-MODE NULL, the second conversion null on the lane, which hands off to OQ-16 rather than stopping the lane.

The full kill criterion outcome

Kill-criterion outcome: by the pinned partition, Stage I PASSED plus Stage C NOT-WIN equals CONVERSION-MODE NULL, the second conversion null on the lane, which hands off to OQ-16 rather than stopping the lane. One descriptive observation survives without a registered CI: head_free posted the highest tokens per call on both seeds at a budget below vanilla's.

Fold-back #2 (F-22 with DR-1 .. DR-4; closed by F-23)

The full summary

The full summary

After F-23 the question moved one level up: not "is the reconstruction target free" but "does the existence margin itself survive a FULL free baseline" - the 657 summaries of p_a plus a hashed multi-hot of the anchor's top-32 next-token ids plus the z-scored anchor state h_a, read by a registered AdamW reader at mlp256 (30 epochs, the epoch selected on val; one to three passes at F-24's pinned L1 cells, more at F-25's L2 / L3 cells, where the per-cell best epochs are in the payloads), with an equal-dims alignment-destroyed twin pricing dilution. OQ-17 (F-24) ran it at the pinned L1 offset-2 cells of both sources on both harvests: every gate D has its CI95 upper below the +0.005 materiality floor (S1 +0.0002 [-0.0012, +0.0015] / +0.0012 [-0.0003, +0.0028]; S3 +0.0003 [-0.0013, +0.0020] / +0.0001 [-0.0019, +0.0021]), the registered ABSORBED condition (every D row, linear and offset-3 included, with its CI95 upper below +0.005 and no fire on either harvest), while telemetry on top of the full free baseline still adds about +0.003 (Mt) CI-clear on three of four harvests - matched by the corrected twin's own gain (Mn_r +0.0032 [+0.0016, +0.0050] / +0.0020 [+0.0002, +0.0037] at S1; the S3 pair is in the entry), under which Mt stops being evidence of telemetry information. The pinned prediction (S1 SURVIVES-FULL-FREE; S3 SPLIT or NOT-SHOWN) failed on both sources. The S1 critic recompute found the registered shift twin NOT inert; a post-hoc diagnostic, registered before it ran, re-read the gate against a corrected prompt-level-deranged twin: TWIN-ROBUST at both sources, so the null does not depend on the control. OQ-18 (F-25) extended the same test to the coarse labels L2 / L3. Its registered leak rider fired at S1 L3 (raw leg 2 +0.0132 against the 0.01 band); a dated amendment replaced that leg with a twin-referenced dependence-excess leg after the fire - disclosed in the entry's preface as a post-hoc reroute around a fired kill condition, fresh only at the other three harvests, with a positive control confirming the amended leg fires on a literal non-causal block; the registered raw leg is reported at every cell and was above its band at two (S1 L3 +0.0132, S1_r L2 +0.0105), and at S1 L3 the amended pass is not a CI-clear null (dE_br +0.0026, upper +0.0054). Labels: S1 L2 ABSORBED, S1 L3 NOT-SHOWN, S3 L2 ABSORBED, S3 L3 SPLIT (fired on the replication harvest only, D +0.0053 [+0.0019, +0.0091] decomposing into Mt -0.0014 [-0.0041, +0.0016] and the twin's own cost Mn_r -0.0067, so the entry's post-hoc line reads it as inflated by up to 0.0067 and not as half a survival), every L3 label read through the lopsided group lens the registration names.

The full summary

With the thesis closed negative at the registered reader, the lane turned to the prefetch half of OQ-9 on the committed OLMoE router harvests - cells the registration pins as OCCUPIED (address-only history tables, cross-layer routing predictors, and draft-conditioned expert prefetch, SP-MoE; the history and cross-layer ids to verify) - measured here with the record's own free baseline and no model forward. The estimand is a hit rate: of the next forward's eight experts per gate, the share inside a resident set of B of 64, linear ridge readers, 30 test prompts. At B = 16, horizon 1, a recency cache covers 0.5197 / 0.5155, the free one-token train table 0.8111 / 0.8036, the routing history alone 0.8064 / 0.8056, and history plus the token 0.9143 / 0.9108 (F-26). The four readings all read SIGNAL: HISTORY +0.2867 / +0.2901 over the cache, ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN +0.1032 [+0.0926, +0.1146] / +0.1072 [+0.0952, +0.1206] over the one-token table (below the +0.05 floor at B = 32 for j = 1: +0.0405 / +0.0434, while the B = 32 margin at j = 3 / 4 reads +0.0683 / +0.0654 and +0.0698 / +0.0669 with CI lower above the floor), INTRA-FORWARD +0.4861 / +0.4816 (gate l from the earlier gates of the same forward), and the perfect-draft ceiling at horizon 2 +0.1556 / +0.1545; stage label PREFETCH-HEADROOM, the seed replication agreeing on every label. The landing critic's one blocking objection was on interpretation: the previous token is exactly as free as the current one, is not in the one-token baseline, and gate 0 routes on it (an unresolved alternative, that the stored gate-0 slot lags one forward, is recorded in F-26's GATE-0 NOTE). That became the free-bigram twin, registered as a dated amendment with both predictions pinned (the critic's: the margin drops to or below the floor) and run on 2026-10-01: with the previous token in the baseline at equal dims the address block still adds +0.0609 [+0.0514, +0.0712] / +0.0659 [+0.0547, +0.0788] (D_eq) and the address stream over the free bigram +0.0661 / +0.0705 (D_add) - SURVIVES; both pinned modal expectations had put D_eq below material (the critic's clause FAILED, the assistant's modal label MISSED) - while the free previous token accounts for 0.4104 / 0.3858 of the re-measured margin (point ratios) and both readings fall below the floor at B = 32 (the twin ran at horizon 1 only; the horizon 2..4 margins are over the one-token table and were never tested against the bigram twin). The critic's coverage caveat is carried on every text: on val the covered-key D_eq is +0.0454 / +0.0472, below the floor, against +0.12..+0.45 on the primary where a token key is unseen (an unregistered diagnostic, not evidence), so the material part of the surviving margin sits where the free tables are blind; the diagnostic locates the margin without naming its mechanism, and nothing in the entry reads any of this as context information in the address stream or as support for the sideband premise. F-26's post-hoc reading (NOT a registered readout; it changes no label and licenses nothing) records that ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN stays near +0.10 at every horizon 1..4 (+0.1032 to +0.0933 primary, +0.1072 to +0.0912 replication) while the token's own margin over the cache decays from +0.2913 to +0.0427 (+0.2881 to +0.0415), with the entry's own qualifier that "routing history" may be standing in for free token history; the twin tested horizon 1 only. The stratified coverage read (2026-10-02; registered as a dated amendment before any readout ran, both runs from the freeze commit fea2431) split the twin's test bigram positions by train-table coverage and added the forward's stored output-distribution summaries (mass16, mass64, entropy; 81 coordinates) as a free block in both arms. Precondition REPRODUCE EXACT on both harvests: the stratified rows sum to the twin's 12,960 committed state rows and the pooled D_eq equals the twin's. Label FALLBACK-LOCATED / PT-SURVIVES on both, the seed replication agreeing, both gates straddling the +0.05 floor at B = 16, j = 1. Q1 (coverage): on the covered positions (0.9013 / 0.8582 of the test positions) D_eq +0.0463 [+0.0398, +0.0541] / +0.0481 [+0.0411, +0.0564] (NOT-SHOWN, the floor inside the CI); on the positions with at least one unseen key (0.0987 / 0.1418) +0.1940 [+0.1596, +0.2280] / +0.1741 [+0.1390, +0.2154] (SIGNAL). Q2 (p_t), with the summaries in both arms on all positions: D_eq^PT +0.0532 [+0.0455, +0.0619] / +0.0565 [+0.0480, +0.0664] (SIGNAL, the floor inside the CI) and D_add^PT +0.0583 [+0.0506, +0.0669] / +0.0609 [+0.0525, +0.0709] (SIGNAL); PT GAIN on all positions +0.0089 / +0.0121, on the covered ones +0.0011 / +0.0008. So the caveat is indicated on the unseen-key positions, not settled: a statement about per-position materiality, not about where the pooled margin accrues, since by the point identity the covered positions carry +0.0417 / +0.0412 of the pooled +0.0609 / +0.0659 (0.686 / 0.626 of it); the union's margin is not confined to the unseen keys (D_add^PT on the covered positions +0.0512 / +0.0525, SIGNAL, the floor inside the CI); and where the margin sits is budget-dependent (at B = 8 the covered positions read SIGNAL, D_eq +0.0642 / +0.0672; at B = 32 every Q2 reading is CI-positive below the floor, D_eq^PT +0.0184 / +0.0200 and D_add^PT +0.0197 / +0.0213, where Q2 would read PT-ABSORBS on positions whose pooled twin margin was already below it). The twin's verdict with p_t is not settled at this power; no stage-2 sentence follows, and F-26's sentence stands. PT-SURVIVES says nothing about F-24's full-free block ((a) ++ TOK ++ z-scored h_a, stored in these harvests), the named stronger free arm for the p_t question, and the reported-only pt_only arm's lambda sits at the grid's lower edge on both harvests. The full summary

Every conversion verdict's CI is cross-prompt at one seed, and the +0.062 bar with the F-19 WIN rule was priced against those CIs; F-27 prices the seed-to-seed noise of the same estimand on the four committed vanilla gamma-4 verdict runs (two seed pairs on two 210-prompt populations), CPU only, pre-registered with the critic's three rounds before the freeze. A same-policy seed change moves pooled tokens/call by a CI95 half-width of 0.0385 / 0.0398 at 210 prompts and 0.0982 / 0.1032 at 30 (K3 / OQ15); one seed's per-prompt tokens/call correlates 0.4232 [0.3073, 0.5193] / 0.4172 [0.2990, 0.5224] with the other seed's (0.2944 / 0.3368 within families); at n = 30 a +0.062 point win appears by seed noise alone in 0.1060 / 0.1320 of subsets and a single comparator leg of the F-19 rule passes in 0.0235 / 0.0375 (the guard cannot bind between fixed-gamma vanilla runs, so the guarded rate is the same number). Labels FLOOR-MATERIAL on both populations, BAR-RESOLVED@210, RULE-LEAKS@30; the methods note is docs/NOISE_FLOOR.md. What it is not: a cross-seed, same-policy, single-comparator null, while the record's gate legs are same-seed and all-comparator; that null is unmeasured, and no verdict, label or kill status moves (NON-CRITERION). PRIMARY grid: generation seeds 0..7, 1,647,264 pairs (volume bar met; splits 1,174,184/235,460/237,620), 156 registered cells + 6 R2 shuffle, partial=false, commit 808266e-dirty. REPLICATION (pinned BEFORE the primary grid existed — stronger timing than S1's, which pinned after seeing which triples fired; gate = L1_olmoe_k16/off2/linear re-fires all three conditions, non-firing branches verbatim from the S1 replication registration): fresh seeds 8..11 into the separate dir harvest_moe_r, 827,324 pairs (the tool's EXIT_BAR_NOT_MET verdict is the Phase-2 FULL-harvest rule, superseded by the registration's 4-seed pin; ran with --skip-preflight over a Windows pending-reboot advisory, flag recorded in meta args), commit 83406b1-dirty (all -dirty = untracked-only, operator-attested). Riders, both harvests: R1-S3 fidelity 16/16 PASS first attempt at rng-seed 0 / 1 (registered lineage), calibrated tolerances (expert overlap >= 5/8, mass L-inf 0.20, entropy 0.50, argmax-gap 0.20), worst observed overlap 7/8 on both, worst mass L-inf 5.57e-02 / 2.62e-02 vs calibration band 0.0666; R2 label-shuffle PASS at every offset on both runs (primary gaps <= 1.7e-5, replication <= 3.7e-4); audits clean (contamination test-in-train distinct/occurrence 0.52%/0.64% primary, 0.37%/0.47% replication; loopy rows 0 on both). Label spaces L1_olmoe_k16 / L2_olmoe_k512 (concept + merged glue class 510) / L3_olmoe_groups_v1 (fixed committed artifact, fit on the primary train chain only, sha-identical for both grids, never refit); features (a) = ALL logged free summaries of p_a, (b) = expert multi-hot (16 x 64 = 1024 dims), (c) = both, (h) = 2048-dim hidden reference (OQ-6 denominator); capacities linear + mlp256 per the registered economy; train seeds {0,1,2}; estimand identical to S1 (per-prompt paired successes summed over train seeds, ONE prompt-cluster bootstrap CI95 over the 30 test prompts, n_boot 2000, seed 0). Critic recomputed BOTH grids' full decisions from the state files alone (margins, CIs, per-seed points, firing sets, R2, floors, OQ-6) — bit-exact on both, zero blockers — before either verdict landed. Registered pre-run (OQ-16 FOLD-BACK #2 ARC REGISTRATION, commit bd71358): target = the byproduct-logged anchor hidden state h_a (model.norm output, 4096 dims, float16 on disk — the cast is part of the target), z-scored per coordinate on pooled TRAIN moments; features = anchor-time core only through the committed scheduler.probe_input (FREE 657 / TEL 2705 / NOISE = F-16 shift 17; NO q_sig — it does not exist at the anchor, critic-verified in k3_live/hf_specdec); prompt-level 126/42/42 splits per population (Stage-I recipe), cluster = (population, prompt), 84 TEST clusters; multi-output closed-form ridge, lambda the only DOF over the WIDENED grid 1e-2..1e5; estimand = pooled TEST standardized MSE, deltas by stats.paired_ratio_delta_ci (per-cluster SSE / position counts, n_boot 2000, seed 0); GATE = two-leg AND: leg 1 delta_noise CI-lower > 0 AND point > stale_mean + 3 sd AND point > stale max over a GATING five-seed stale-target control (DI-1 recipe, lambda re-selected inside every control); leg 2 delta_free CI-lower > 0. Three design decisions put to the user before the registration (all-four-vanilla-runs / two-leg gate / direction proxy reported-only). The full regime line

MATHEMATICAL IDENTITY, numerically checked on REAL byproduct rows (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct lm_head, untied and bias-free, read from the cached bf16 checkpoint as float32; 48 pinned rows = the first 4 blocks of the first 3 prompts of each of the four registered vanilla gamma-4 verdict runs, every npz sha-bound to its committed summary; CPU compute on the GPU box — the tool needs the cached weights and the gitignored raws; CI imports the module through tests/test_ha_identity.py, where torch and safetensors load lazily, and never runs it; the identity is generic to any linear unembedding of full column rank with vocab > d, tied or untied, and is measured here on one model). CLAIM: h_a (the final-norm output at the anchor, the registered Stage-R target) is determined by the anchor's logits, and therefore by the anchor's full next-token distribution p — the quantity D-5 names as the mandatory free baseline ("steering from the target's distribution at the last verified position, which every speculative decoder computes anyway"). W_U @ h reproduces the logged argmax 48/48 and the logged top-32 ids at 0.9948 mean overlap (min 0.969; max top-1 probability gap 0.0206 against the values logged by the live bf16 lm_head of the NF4-loaded verifier); the least-squares inverse from the float32 logits recovers h_a at median relative error 2.5e-8 (max 3.2e-8), the float32 rounding floor (from float64 logits 1.9e-14); closed-form least-squares recovery from only the top-k (id, log-prob) pairs of the recomputed logits (not the logged float16 pairs) reaches median per-row R^2 +1.0000 at k = 4097, +0.506 at 2048, +0.216 at 512, +0.078 at 128, +0.014 at 32 (median cosines 1.000 / 0.711 / 0.465 / 0.280 / 0.123) — a per-row R^2 about the row's own mean in raw h space from a prior-free solve, NOT Stage-R's standardized pooled-MSE R^2 and not comparable to the ridge arms' +0.258 / +0.324; the top-k recovery uses log-probabilities only with the log-partition as an extra unknown, so p alone, not the logits, determines h_a. CONDITIONING: W_U has full column rank (singular values 1.453 .. 94.5, condition 65); the all-ones vector, the softmax's free direction, lies 99.2% inside col(W_U), yet the augmented system [W_U, -1] has smallest singular value 1.451, so nothing is weakly determined; from bfloat16-rounded full log-probabilities with logZ unknown, h_a recovers to median relative error 3.5e-03 (max 6.9e-03). WHAT STANDS: every Stage-R and DR-1..DR-4 readout as pinned (F-22) — the gates were run against their registered arms and recomputed bit-exact. WHAT FALLS: their meaning for the lane. The registered FREE arm (657 anchor summaries; R^2 +0.083) and the DR-2/DR-4 token encodings (FREETOK +0.258, FREETOK2 +0.255) were lossy proxies for the free information D-5 names, from which the target follows exactly (R^2 1.000); the stream's reconstruction (TEL +0.253; UNION +0.324) is therefore K-2's "lossy copy of information the decoder already has", with no hashing caveat and no further comparator needed — "beyond p" is priced at this target: nothing is. The Stage-A telemetry arms (F = FREETOK reconstruction, T = UNION reconstruction) are struck pre-GPU: a host that computes p for rejection sampling can inject h_a itself with at most one least-squares solve against the cached lm_head (a 4096 x 128256 matvec plus a precomputed 4096 x 4096 inverse; this harness holds h_a directly through its final-norm catch). "Free" is D-5's convention; D-1's premise never priced shipping p or h_a to a disaggregated drafter (K-6 territory, not settled here). The oracle arm O (true h_a) is thereby the DEPLOYABLE free-actuator arm — SD^2-lite from the verifier's own distribution — whose V-vs-O readout sits outside the K-3 kill text and this lane's claim; it needs its own registration if run (label FREE-ACTUATOR WIN / NULL; a WIN is an SD^2 configuration result, not a sideband result). WHAT IT DOES NOT TOUCH, AND WHY: the existence results F-15/F-17 concern future-position concepts at offsets 2-3, which the anchor's p does not determine; but their free arm (a) is the same 657-summary proxy, so "beyond p?" arises there too, and the record's answer is the OQ-6 h-probe row of the same grids (margins_h_vs_a in results/real/probes_s1{,_replication}.json and probes_s3{,_replication}.json): under the identity a linear probe on h_a is a linear probe on the full logit vector, the strongest linear free-p baseline, and at the pinned L1 offset-2 cells it adds nothing over (a) — h-a margin S1 +0.0009 [-0.0087, +0.0107] primary, -0.0012 [-0.0112, +0.0090] replication; S3 -0.0026 [-0.0071, +0.0021], -0.0042 [-0.0093, +0.0015] — against c-a margins +0.0163 / +0.0141 (S1) and +0.0147 / +0.0173 (S3), and sits below (a) at offsets 3-4 on all four grids (offset-3 h-a -0.0205 / -0.0399 / -0.0111 / -0.0173). The K-2 margins are therefore not linear-logit information and F-15/F-17 stand; a NONLINEAR-in-p free baseline at the registered mlp256 capacity was never run and is the unrun K-2 comparator (not authorized here). The topic controls F-16/F-18 and the conversion nulls F-19/F-21 stand on their own. The only reconstruction target where telemetry could carry non-free information is h at FUTURE anchors (OQ-16's own anticipatory variant, never run); the fold-back-#2 hard stop forbids a third arc without the user's explicit exception. CLASSIFICATION: no partition branch is claimed. The limbo clause's condition is met (a Stage A never run after a PASS) and its rule, "neither limbo may ever be re-labeled a null", is honored; the catch-all is not invoked because the branch it would name (RECONSTRUCTION-CEILING NULL, "Stage-R leg 1 fails") is contradicted by the measured leg-1 pass; the disposition is the partition's own VOID precedent (no branch claimed, a dated note, the lane stops in practice under the fold-back-#2 hard stop). The lane is CLOSED BY DATED ERRATUM, mechanism TARGET-FREE; STAGE-R PASS stands as the mechanical outcome of its gate; the DR-3 OUTCOME's "reopens the Stage-A telemetry question" sentence is superseded. The lane ENDS. DISCLOSURE: the target was chosen for logging convenience (model.norm, one hook) rather than SD^2's mid-layer read (layers 3, L/2, L-2), which no identity of this kind ties to p (many-to-one; how much of those states p predicts is unmeasured); the free arm was built from the existing probe_input summaries rather than from D-5's definition; three diagnostics priced "beyond FREETOK's encoding" while the closed-form free comparator was one linear solve away. The observation came from the 2026-09-05 creative-lens adversarial pass over the gathered data (contrarian lens), reproduced by that pass's verifier, by an operator scratch check and by the committed tool; CRITIC RECOMPUTE ROUND (2026-09-05, before this commit): an independent implementation (float64 QR inverse; SVD least squares for the top-k solves; log-probabilities only) reproduced the forward numbers exactly, the full-logit inverse to 8 significant figures and every k < 4097 number to 7 or more digits; it exposed the first draft's k = 4097 row (median +0.9999, min 0.9988) as an artifact of an ill-conditioned normal-equations solve with a 1e-8 ridge, replaced by the committed SVD solve, and confirmed full column rank and the augmented-system conditioning above; it also blocked three sentences of the first draft — a "mechanical" catch-all classification against the limbo clause, an unargued "does not touch F-15/F-17", and a "standardized R^2" label — all rewritten before the commit. ATTESTATION: results/real/oq16_ha_identity.json carries git_commit 8542ef5-dirty; at run time the tracked dirt was this commit's own documentation and registration text, the tool and its test were untracked, and every input is sha-bound (lm_head shard sha256 and the twelve npz sha256s in the file).

Arms per harvest, identical block order: fplus = (a) 657 logged summaries of p_a ++ TOK (multi-hot of the anchor's top-32 next-token ids hashed mod 2048, the F-22 DR-2 rule) ++ hz (h_a, the final-norm state that produced p_a, clipped to the TRAIN support and z-scored per channel with TRAIN-split moments: S1 4096 dims, 1200 / 600 train rows, 304,461 / 152,763 positions, per-channel sd 0.97..10.29 median 2.11, support to 56.25; S3 2048 dims, 295,346 / 148,876 positions, sd 0.67..6.65 median 2.05, support to 51.25; moments sha256 in every payload); fplus_b = fplus ++ aligned telemetry (S1 2048 slot dims, S3 1024 expert dims); fplus_n = fplus ++ the same row's telemetry at anchor (a+17) mod row-length (the F-16 shift twin; equal dims to fplus_b by construction: S1 8849, S3 5777; fplus 6801 / 4753). Trainer, budget, estimand and bootstrap byte-identical to Phase 3 (30 epochs, VAL-selected epoch; per-prompt paired successes summed over train seeds {0,1,2}, ONE prompt-cluster bootstrap CI95 over the 30 test prompts, n_boot 2000, seed 0). Cells: L1 x off2 x {linear, mlp256} x 3 seeds x 3 arms on every harvest (18), plus L1 x off3 x mlp256 on the two S1 harvests (9; offsets bound to the source tag); a two-leg leak rider first (shuffled fplus vs the committed shuffled (a); shuffled fplus_b vs shuffled fplus; band 0.01). READER-VALIDITY precondition: all nine gate-cell probes hold the majority floor and Mf's gate CI upper >= 0. Gate: L1 / off2 / mlp256 D = acc(fplus_b) - acc(fplus_n) under the Phase-3 triple rule (CI95 lower > 0, all three seeds positive, point >= +0.005); labels per source from BOTH harvests (tools/run_fullfree.py --conclude-from, mechanical): READER-INVALID / SURVIVES-FULL-FREE / SPLIT / ABSORBED (fires on neither AND every D row's CI95 upper < +0.005 on both harvests) / NOT-SHOWN / INCOMPLETE, all scoped to the registered reader at the registered budget; Mt = acc(fplus_b) - acc(fplus) quoted beside D everywhere; Mn = acc(fplus_n) - acc(fplus), Mf = acc(fplus) - acc(a) and Mc = acc(fplus) - acc(c) reported against the committed Phase-3 cells (paired through the sha-bound state files; the committed payload margins re-derived at load to 1e-12). Post-hoc, NON-CRITERION, registered before any of its registered cells ran (same block, "OQ-17 POST-HOC TWIN-INERTNESS DIAGNOSTIC", critic-gated pre-run, committed 675a8f6): arm fplus_r = fplus ++ the slots of the same-generation-index row of a DIFFERENT prompt of the same split at the same anchor index (a prompt-level within-split derangement per train seed); the gate cell only, three seeds, all four harvests; readouts D_r = acc(fplus_b) - acc(fplus_r), Mn_r = acc(fplus_r) - acc(fplus), T = acc(fplus_n) - acc(fplus_r); readings TWIN-ROBUST / TWIN-MASKED (clean fires only) / TWIN-SPLIT / TWIN-DEPENDENT / TWIN-INCOMPLETE plus a T reading; it cannot change a registered label — it pins which qualifier the consequence text carries. The four twin payloads bind 675a8f6 and record the instrument's sha256 and the per-seed permutation sha256. In plain words
ABSORBED
no material margin over the full free baseline at the registered reader, and no more than a scrambled block of the same size adds; the gate fired on neither harvest of the source
NOT-SHOWN
the test could not show the effect; a non-result, not a negative result
SPLIT
the gate fired on one of the source's two harvests and not on the other
OFF3-ABSORBED
the same absorbed reading three positions ahead instead of two
NON-CRITERION
a diagnostic that reports and prices but cannot change a verdict
OFF3-NOT-SHOWN
three positions ahead the test could not show the effect
OFF3-SURVIVES
the margin cleared its floor three positions ahead
SURVIVES-FULL-FREE
the margin cleared the floor against the full free baseline at that cell
FAILED
a pinned prediction failed
SURVIVES
the margin cleared its floor under the registered rule
OFF4-ABSORBED
the same absorbed reading four positions ahead
PASS
the registered gate passed

the registered verdict is unchanged and no later entry narrows it

REAL MODELS (CPU-only readouts on the two committed S3 harvests of allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct, NF4 double-quant with bf16 routers, target-only sampled generations at temperature 1.0, 256 new tokens, the 210 committed short prompts; primary seeds 0..7 (results/real/harvest_moe), replication seeds 8..11 (harvest_moe_r) on the SAME prompts; the sorted top-8 expert ids at the 16 router gates, no router weights; no model forward, no acceptance, no wall clock). Registered 2026-09-14 in docs/BLUEPRINT.md "OQ-9 STAGE-1 PREFETCH READOUTS REGISTRATION" before any readout ran on either harvest, critic-gated through three design passes and a final confirmation, frozen at c4c4511; NON-CRITERION for every existing finding (no K-2 / K-3 verdict, no F-15 / F-17 / F-24 / F-25 sentence and no existence or conversion label is touched); a systems datum for the K-6 memo. ESTIMAND: HIT RATE at residency budget B in {8, 16, 32} of the 64 experts per gate — the number of a target set's eight experts inside the resident set, summed over positions, divided by 8 times the positions; a COUNT, never bytes or latency; B = 16 is the label budget, 8 and 32 are reported. Readers fit on the train prompts (prompt_idx % 7 in {0..4}) pooled over seeds, lambda selected on val (5) from the widened grid {0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 1e4, 1e5}, every number read on the 30 TEST prompts (6) pooled over seeds and positions with prompt-cluster bootstrap CI95 (n_boot 2000, seed 0); paired deltas on identical positions. ARMS per horizon j (S[t] the routing of the forward whose softmax is p_t; tokens[t] sampled from p_t is the FREE bonus token and feeds the forward whose routing is S[t+1] — the convention verified against the harvester pre-freeze and confirmed on the data by the critic's val-only diagnostic at landing): RECENCY_B = the B most recently used experts per gate (the cache policy); MARGINAL_B; FREE_TABLE = zero-fit top-B of TABLE(tokens[t]), the train token-conditional routing frequencies of the forward a token feeds (leave-one-prompt-out at train rows); FREE_TOK = ridge on TABLE(tokens[t]) — a ONE-TOKEN free arm, the D-5 analogue for prefetch as registered; HISTORY = ridge on the S[t] multi-hot, address-only; HISTORY_TOK = S[t] ++ TABLE(tokens[t]); at j = 2 only DRAFT_FREE / DRAFT_FULL add TABLE(tokens[t+1]), the TRUE next token as the D-2-named ceiling draft; INTRA = gate l from gates 0..l-k of the SAME forward (leads 1, 2, 4) against MARGINAL; (iv) a front-loading curve reported only. Readings SIGNAL iff paired CI95 lower > 0 and point >= +0.05 (the pinned materiality floor), NEGATIVE iff CI95 upper < 0, else NOT-SHOWN; HISTORY = HISTORY minus RECENCY_16 (j = 1), ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN = HISTORY_TOK minus FREE_TOK (j = 1), INTRA-FORWARD = INTRA lead 1 minus MARGINAL_16 over target gates 1..15, DRAFT = DRAFT_FULL minus HISTORY_TOK (j = 2); CACHE-SUFFICIENT iff RECENCY_16 at j = 1 >= 0.90; the sideband sentence follows ADDRESS-BEYOND-TOKEN alone. Every label is scoped to the registered linear readers on the sorted top-8 id stream at hit rate at the registered budgets.

Registered 2026-10-04 (docs/BLUEPRINT.md, "SEED-NOISE FLOOR READOUTS REGISTRATION", written before any readout of a seed pair ran, three critic rounds before the freeze), frozen at 906edfd; both runs from the clean tree at that commit. Estimand E6's: tokens/call = sum n_emitted / sum n_blocks on a prompt set; the null delta = the lower seed minus the higher on the same prompts; CI95 by sideband.stats.paired_ratio_delta_ci (n_boot 2000, seed 0), exactly as F-19 and F-21 compute a gate leg; 1,000 subsets without replacement per n below 210, the full set at 210. NON-CRITERION for every finding and kill status: a CROSS-SEED, same-policy, SINGLE-COMPARATOR null, while the record's gate legs are same-seed (D-6) and all-comparator; that same-seed null is not measured (the cross-seed noise is plausibly an upper bound on it, argued from the shared prefix for a policy whose per-prompt variance does not exceed vanilla's; not measured).

Errata and dated notes

When a registered text turned out to be wrong, the record did not rewrite it. It appended a dated erratum, note or amendment beside the text. This timeline is those lines: the 70 lines of the three findings logs that carry a date and one of the words erratum, errata, dated note, amendment, correction, superseded or struck (47 in sideband, 18 in amber, 5 in lockstep), quoted as written, newest month first, each opening from a short preview to the full line. A line is filed under the first date it carries; on a row of sideband's findings table that is the finding's own date, and the note's date comes later in the row.

    The full line, as written
    - DATED NOTE 2026-10-18 (the first free baseline and the routing literature; the cold read of that date, docs/PUBLIC_CUT_PLAN.md 15.8): the free baseline of F-15 and F-17 left token ids out "as non-ordinal" (tools/run_probes.py line 196, a frozen instrument). At S3, where the stream is OLMoE's router address stream, the absorption this finding measured once hashed predicted-token ids (TOK) and the z-scored h_a block entered the baseline together is consistent with two published analyses of MoE routing: OpenMoE (Xue et al., arXiv 2402.01739, 2024) reports routing decisions that depend mainly on the routed input token's ID with little regard to context (TOK holds predicted ids, so of the two only OLMoE's output-id sentence bears on TOK directly), and OLMoE (Muennighoff et al., arXiv 2409.02060, 2024), the paper of the base model behind S3's checkpoint (OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct, docs/METHOD.md line 269; the paper's section 5.4 analyses OLMoE-1B-7B), reports vocabulary specialization of its experts, later layers specializing on predicted output token IDs. Consistent with, not predicted by: the re-test added TOK and the standardized hz block in one arm, so the share of the absorption due to token ids alone was not isolated, and at S1 the stream is top-32-of-512 weight-slot occupancy at the down_proj inputs of a dense Llama (docs/GLOSSARY.md, the telemetry-sources entry), where the routing literature does not apply. Both papers fetched on 2026-10-18 and added to docs/PRIOR_ART.md. Categorical features are routinely one-hot or hash encoded; the exclusion was a design choice the re-test revisited, and the labels stand as written. The probing-practice references added the same day (Pimentel et al. 2020; Hewitt and Liang 2019; Xu et al. 2020) bear on the readers: untuned, scored on top-1 accuracy, and at F-15 and F-17 on raw inputs (this finding's reader reads z-scored h_a); the K-2 word is scoped to the registered reader throughout, and those references name what a stronger reader would be.     - dated note (2026-10-18): what the fp32 contract pins is the dtype alone. The archive header's model block carries id, snapshot and dtype (src/amber/real/archive.py line 39, MODEL_FIELDS) and the capture arm adds device, quantization and batch (src/amber/real/capture.py lines 89-95, Arm); matmul precision, the attention implementation, the torch and transformers versions and the GPU architecture are recorded in the capture's meta.json (capture.py's docstring) and in no archive, so a decoder on another stack is bound by nothing in the file. The bf16 and fp16 failure rates in this title are properties of this PyTorch stack at these settings, not of the formats: ts_zip evaluates its model in BF16 and states that the result "does not depend on the exact GPU or CPU model nor on the number of configured threads" (bellard.org/ts_zip, fetched 2026-10-18; docs/PRIOR_ART.md, 2026-10-18 additions). The counts stand; the dtype pin is a measurement of this stack, not a contract that binds another.

    - dated note (2026-10-18, second, after the critic's recompute of the same day): the note above misstates the scope of the two rates. P4's archives were encoded on cuda fp32 (experiments/P4_PROTOCOL.md line 18) and the bf16 and fp16 decoders read those fp32-encoded archives, so the 84% and 28.5% are cross-dtype figures, a property of the dtype difference between encoder and decoder under this stack; the phrase "not of the formats" is withdrawn. What ts_zip's page bears on is a same-dtype contract, bf16 at both ends with deterministic kernels, which P4 did not measure. The header's model block binds a decoder to nothing beyond id, snapshot and dtype; "bound by nothing in the file" above reads with that qualification.

    The full line, as written
    - regime: MATHEMATICAL IDENTITY, numerically checked on REAL byproduct rows (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct lm_head, untied and bias-free, read from the cached bf16 checkpoint as float32; 48 pinned rows = the first 4 blocks of the first 3 prompts of each of the four registered vanilla gamma-4 verdict runs, every npz sha-bound to its committed summary; CPU compute on the GPU box — the tool needs the cached weights and the gitignored raws; CI imports the module through tests/test_ha_identity.py, where torch and safetensors load lazily, and never runs it; the identity is generic to any linear unembedding of full column rank with vocab > d, tied or untied, and is measured here on one model). CLAIM: h_a (the final-norm output at the anchor, the registered Stage-R target) is determined by the anchor's logits, and therefore by the anchor's full next-token distribution p — the quantity D-5 names as the mandatory free baseline ("steering from the target's distribution at the last verified position, which every speculative decoder computes anyway"). W_U @ h reproduces the logged argmax 48/48 and the logged top-32 ids at 0.9948 mean overlap (min 0.969; max top-1 probability gap 0.0206 against the values logged by the live bf16 lm_head of the NF4-loaded verifier); the least-squares inverse from the float32 logits recovers h_a at median relative error 2.5e-8 (max 3.2e-8), the float32 rounding floor (from float64 logits 1.9e-14); closed-form least-squares recovery from only the top-k (id, log-prob) pairs of the recomputed logits (not the logged float16 pairs) reaches median per-row R^2 +1.0000 at k = 4097, +0.506 at 2048, +0.216 at 512, +0.078 at 128, +0.014 at 32 (median cosines 1.000 / 0.711 / 0.465 / 0.280 / 0.123) — a per-row R^2 about the row's own mean in raw h space from a prior-free solve, NOT Stage-R's standardized pooled-MSE R^2 and not comparable to the ridge arms' +0.258 / +0.324; the top-k recovery uses log-probabilities only with the log-partition as an extra unknown, so p alone, not the logits, determines h_a. CONDITIONING: W_U has full column rank (singular values 1.453 .. 94.5, condition 65); the all-ones vector, the softmax's free direction, lies 99.2% inside col(W_U), yet the augmented system [W_U, -1] has smallest singular value 1.451, so nothing is weakly determined; from bfloat16-rounded full log-probabilities with logZ unknown, h_a recovers to median relative error 3.5e-03 (max 6.9e-03). WHAT STANDS: every Stage-R and DR-1..DR-4 readout as pinned (F-22) — the gates were run against their registered arms and recomputed bit-exact. WHAT FALLS: their meaning for the lane. The registered FREE arm (657 anchor summaries; R^2 +0.083) and the DR-2/DR-4 token encodings (FREETOK +0.258, FREETOK2 +0.255) were lossy proxies for the free information D-5 names, from which the target follows exactly (R^2 1.000); the stream's reconstruction (TEL +0.253; UNION +0.324) is therefore K-2's "lossy copy of information the decoder already has", with no hashing caveat and no further comparator needed — "beyond p" is priced at this target: nothing is. The Stage-A telemetry arms (F = FREETOK reconstruction, T = UNION reconstruction) are struck pre-GPU: a host that computes p for rejection sampling can inject h_a itself with at most one least-squares solve against the cached lm_head (a 4096 x 128256 matvec plus a precomputed 4096 x 4096 inverse; this harness holds h_a directly through its final-norm catch). "Free" is D-5's convention; D-1's premise never priced shipping p or h_a to a disaggregated drafter (K-6 territory, not settled here). The oracle arm O (true h_a) is thereby the DEPLOYABLE free-actuator arm — SD^2-lite from the verifier's own distribution — whose V-vs-O readout sits outside the K-3 kill text and this lane's claim; it needs its own registration if run (label FREE-ACTUATOR WIN / NULL; a WIN is an SD^2 configuration result, not a sideband result). WHAT IT DOES NOT TOUCH, AND WHY: the existence results F-15/F-17 concern future-position concepts at offsets 2-3, which the anchor's p does not determine; but their free arm (a) is the same 657-summary proxy, so "beyond p?" arises there too, and the record's answer is the OQ-6 h-probe row of the same grids (margins_h_vs_a in results/real/probes_s1{,_replication}.json and probes_s3{,_replication}.json): under the identity a linear probe on h_a is a linear probe on the full logit vector, the strongest linear free-p baseline, and at the pinned L1 offset-2 cells it adds nothing over (a) — h-a margin S1 +0.0009 [-0.0087, +0.0107] primary, -0.0012 [-0.0112, +0.0090] replication; S3 -0.0026 [-0.0071, +0.0021], -0.0042 [-0.0093, +0.0015] — against c-a margins +0.0163 / +0.0141 (S1) and +0.0147 / +0.0173 (S3), and sits below (a) at offsets 3-4 on all four grids (offset-3 h-a -0.0205 / -0.0399 / -0.0111 / -0.0173). The K-2 margins are therefore not linear-logit information and F-15/F-17 stand; a NONLINEAR-in-p free baseline at the registered mlp256 capacity was never run and is the unrun K-2 comparator (not authorized here). The topic controls F-16/F-18 and the conversion nulls F-19/F-21 stand on their own. The only reconstruction target where telemetry could carry non-free information is h at FUTURE anchors (OQ-16's own anticipatory variant, never run); the fold-back-#2 hard stop forbids a third arc without the user's explicit exception. CLASSIFICATION: no partition branch is claimed. The limbo clause's condition is met (a Stage A never run after a PASS) and its rule, "neither limbo may ever be re-labeled a null", is honored; the catch-all is not invoked because the branch it would name (RECONSTRUCTION-CEILING NULL, "Stage-R leg 1 fails") is contradicted by the measured leg-1 pass; the disposition is the partition's own VOID precedent (no branch claimed, a dated note, the lane stops in practice under the fold-back-#2 hard stop). The lane is CLOSED BY DATED ERRATUM, mechanism TARGET-FREE; STAGE-R PASS stands as the mechanical outcome of its gate; the DR-3 OUTCOME's "reopens the Stage-A telemetry question" sentence is superseded. The lane ENDS. DISCLOSURE: the target was chosen for logging convenience (model.norm, one hook) rather than SD^2's mid-layer read (layers 3, L/2, L-2), which no identity of this kind ties to p (many-to-one; how much of those states p predicts is unmeasured); the free arm was built from the existing probe_input summaries rather than from D-5's definition; three diagnostics priced "beyond FREETOK's encoding" while the closed-form free comparator was one linear solve away. The observation came from the 2026-09-05 creative-lens adversarial pass over the gathered data (contrarian lens), reproduced by that pass's verifier, by an operator scratch check and by the committed tool; CRITIC RECOMPUTE ROUND (2026-09-05, before this commit): an independent implementation (float64 QR inverse; SVD least squares for the top-k solves; log-probabilities only) reproduced the forward numbers exactly, the full-logit inverse to 8 significant figures and every k < 4097 number to 7 or more digits; it exposed the first draft's k = 4097 row (median +0.9999, min 0.9988) as an artifact of an ill-conditioned normal-equations solve with a 1e-8 ridge, replaced by the committed SVD solve, and confirmed full column rank and the augmented-system conditioning above; it also blocked three sentences of the first draft — a "mechanical" catch-all classification against the limbo clause, an unargued "does not touch F-15/F-17", and a "standardized R^2" label — all rewritten before the commit. ATTESTATION: results/real/oq16_ha_identity.json carries git_commit 8542ef5-dirty; at run time the tracked dirt was this commit's own documentation and registration text, the tool and its test were untracked, and every input is sha-bound (lm_head shard sha256 and the twelve npz sha256s in the file).

    - WHAT OQ-16 ACTUALLY ANSWERED (the ledger's literal question — "what fraction of SD^2's vector survives reconstruction from the address stream?"): linearly, about a quarter (R^2 ~0.25, median direction cosine ~0.50 in standardized space, with the support clip) — and a free encoding of the output distribution's top-32 token identities, which the same verify forward hands over anyway, recovers at least as much (CI-clear). At this readout the telemetry margin is therefore not evidence of information beyond what p already reveals; whether telemetry adds anything ON TOP of p is DR-3's question. (DATED NOTE 2026-09-04: DR-3 answered it — see the DR-3 ADDENDUM in the DR block above; this sentence, the "ties a free encoding of p" phrase, and the K-2 location below are SUPERSEDED in the addendum's qualified sense: the stream adds beyond FREETOK's hashed encoding of p, CI-clear; "beyond p" itself is unpriced pending DR-4.) Located against the kill criteria: this is K-2's "a lossy copy of information the decoder already has" at the reconstruction level; it does not re-fire K-2 (that verdict was on future-concept probes at offsets >= 2, F-15, a different target). This is the OQ-6 h-probe story from the other side: extracting FROM h under a cheap budget lost to telemetry (committed), and reconstructing TOWARD h from telemetry ties a free encoding of p. - FORMAL STATE + STAGE-A DECISION INPUTS: by the pinned partition, Stage R is a PASS (the registered FREE arm was probe_input's 657 dims; FREETOK was not a registered baseline and DR-2 is NON-CRITERION) and Stage A (SD^2-style draft-side injection of the reconstructed vector) is AUTHORIZED and USER-GATED; nothing runs from this finding, and the lane hard-stops after Stage A regardless of its outcome. HONEST WEIGHT for that decision, in the registration's own words: DR-2's TOKEN-IDENTITY-NOT-EXCLUDED label is carried into the Stage-A cost decision and mandates FREETOK (or a stronger token-identity encoding) as a free comparator in any actuator economics. With DR-3 in view (the addendum above): a Stage-A telemetry test now HAS a reconstruction-level basis — the UNION reconstruction is CI-clear better than the FREETOK one (R^2 +0.324 vs +0.258), so the Stage-A telemetry claim pinned for the freeze is UNION-vs-FREETOK at the actuator, both free-augmented (the STAGE-A FREEZE landed 2026-09-05 in docs/BLUEPRINT.md, pre-GPU, critic-gated twice: SD^2-style up-projection injection with a frozen drafter and a rank-512 zero-initialised adapter; arms vanilla / oracle_h (TRUE h_a, the actuator ceiling, D-2-named) / free_inject = FREETOK / tel_inject = UNION on the fresh 210-prompt data/prompts_oq16_verdict.jsonl population (mechanical paraphrase refusal against all four committed sets, 0 overlaps); ladder A0 (oracle vs vanilla at the unchanged E6 +0.062 bar) before A1 (the free-actuator readout F-vs-V and the telemetry verdict T-vs-V AND T-vs-F); each rung user-launched; DR-4's COMPARATOR-TOOTHLESS label and its pinned recommendation are carried into the user's A1 decision); a TEL-vs-FREETOK actuator test would have none (TEL is CI-clear slightly worse than FREETOK). Two conversion nulls on this lane (F-20/F-21) remain the closest precedents, and whether a +0.065 standardized-MSE increment in the reconstructed vector moves acceptance at matched budget is unmeasured — no probability is licensed either way. What Stage A could also measure is whether an SD^2-style injection of a FREE reconstruction converts at all (a different question, outside the K-3 kill text's telemetry claim, and not authorized by this partition without its own registration). Mandatory Stage-A freeze elements pinned by this finding: the support clip (or an sd floor) on every live feature — an actuator injecting a 5.76-MSE reconstruction on an out-of-support prompt is worse than nothing (critic A3); a lambda family containing the trivial predictor; the pairwise-selected-budget check (F-21); and — DR-2 having landed TOKEN-IDENTITY-NOT-EXCLUDED — the FREETOK arm (or a stronger token-identity encoding) as a mandatory free comparator in the actuator economics. What the pass says: a linear map from the address stream recovers the anchor state's direction at median cosine ~0.5 in standardized space and beats the free features in every test cluster; what it does not say: that the recovered subspace is the steering-relevant one (Stage A's question), that the margin survives raw-h-space injection (the standardized/raw distinction is pinned), or that any of this converts to tokens/call at matched budget (two nulls on this lane say the conversion bar is high).

Lessons from the record's own limitations

sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:1 · 61a765b6939d
In plain wordsA note the sideband record wrote about its own limitations after a read only audit of its own code and record. For each one: the mechanism of the mistake, what it cost as measured, the rule the next instrument follows, and where the repository itself does not yet follow that rule.

Written 2026-10-16 as the closing step of lane B of the public-cut plan, after the 2026-10-15 image audit (docs/audits/2026-10-15-image-audit/README.md, the audit's report with the recompute scripts beside it). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:3 · 61a765b6939d

The note's preamble, as written

Written 2026-10-16 as the closing step of lane B of the public-cut plan, after the 2026-10-15 image audit (docs/audits/2026-10-15-image-audit/README.md, the audit's report with the recompute scripts beside it). Each entry below is a limitation that stays in the evidence: the instruments are frozen (their bytes are attested by committed payloads) and the registered runs are not repeated, so the record carries a dated note or erratum beside the affected text instead of a fix. For each one: the mechanism, the cost as measured, the rule the next instrument follows, and where the repository itself does not yet follow the rule. The dated notes in FINDINGS.md, DECISIONS.md and docs/BLUEPRINT.md are the primary text; this file is a derived reading aid, and on any disagreement the record's dated note wins. Figures quoted from the audit folder's reruns of 2026-10-16 name their file; the counts in entries 7, 8 and 13 were measured on the tree the same day by the commands named. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:3 · 61a765b6939d

1. A mechanism sentence copied forward past the code

sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:15 · 61a765b6939d
Mechanism
"the HF adapter recomputes prefixes" was written on 2026-08-29 and was false from a commit later that day (b1dae57, cropped KV caches by default). Twelve files carried the sentence, eight of them written after that commit, because each new document copied it from the last one instead of the code; a thirteenth, docs/METHOD.md, quotes the critic's rule that carried it. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:17 · 61a765b6939d
Measured cost
fifteen false or stale statements, zero numbers moved; the ban itself was right for a different reason (no benchmark harness exists). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:22 · 61a765b6939d
Rule
a mechanism claim has one home (here DECISIONS.md D-9 and its dated note of 2026-10-16); every other file cites the home rather than restating the mechanism, and a ban states its own ground, not a code detail that can change. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:24 · 61a765b6939d
Not yet followed by
this lane's own dated notes, which restate the b1dae57 mechanism beside each stale sentence so that a reader of that sentence alone sees the correction; the cost is accepted, and tests/test_record_claims.py pins the code default they cite. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:27 · 61a765b6939d

Cites D-9

2. Intervals that are conditional on the trained seeds

sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:31 · 61a765b6939d
Mechanism
every probe CI is a prompt-cluster bootstrap over counts summed across three train seeds (tools/run_probes.py, frozen), so it is conditional on those three trained probes; the registered all-seeds rule protects the fire direction only. The registered disclosure that the seed "only shuffles AdamW batch order" was false: the trainer seeds the initial weights too (dated erratum in docs/BLUEPRINT.md). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:33 · 61a765b6939d
Measured cost
across the 40 D rows the seed SE runs 0.33 to 3.26 times the bootstrap SE (docs/audits/2026-10-15-image-audit/seed_var_out.json, which brackets 72 rows of F-24, its corrected twin and F-25; F-15 to F-18 and F-28 are not bracketed). No label moves under the three approximations. Three bracketed readings are seed-sensitive: F-25's S1 L2 deciding row, +0.0022 [+0.0003, +0.0039], reads [-0.0012, +0.0055] / [-0.00065, +0.00498] / [-0.0002, +0.0064]; F-24's S1 corrected-twin CI-clear reading is lost under two of three; F-24's S3 linear CI-positive qualifier is lost under all three. A fourth, descriptive reading, the primary S3 L3 Mn_r below-zero value behind F-25's post-hoc "same shape" sentence, has its upper above zero under all three. Three seeds are two degrees of freedom; the component is bracketed, not measured. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:38 · 61a765b6939d
Rule
a registration states what its interval conditions on, in the regime line, and either registers a seed-inclusive interval beside the cluster bootstrap or says the seed component is unmeasured; a disclosure about a trainer is written after reading the trainer. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:48 · 61a765b6939d
Not yet followed by
F-28's SURVIVES-STRONGER cells and the F-15 to F-18 margins, which carry the conditioning note but no bracket (F-28's dated note of 2026-10-16 says so). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:52 · 61a765b6939d

3. A scorer that ran live without its support clip

sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:55 · 61a765b6939d
Mechanism
the frozen Stage-C heads (tools/train_outcome_head.py) export TRAIN moments but no TRAIN support, and the live scorer applies only the [0, 1] output clip; the standardization pathology that F-22 (iii) records for Stage R reached the live decisions of F-21, where the record said nothing about it. Stage A was pinned with "the support clip live" without back-checking Stage C. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:57 · 61a765b6939d
Measured cost
a counterfactual TRAIN-support clip changes 41 of 17,185 consulted decisions on arm 6 and 41 of 17,616 on arm 7 (0.24% / 0.23%); a first-order estimate of the direct tokens/call effect is at most 0.0119 / 0.0116 (five drafted tokens between a stop at position 1 and an extension to six; the rest of a changed prompt's trajectory is not priced), inside every interval of F-21; the replay matches all logged decisions (docs/audits/2026-10-15-image-audit/replay_c1.json). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:62 · 61a765b6939d
Rule
a scorer that runs live carries its TRAIN support clip, pinned at the freeze; when a pathology is found in one stage, every stage that shares the code path is back-checked in the same landing. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:69 · 61a765b6939d

4. The percentile bootstrap at thirty clusters

sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:73 · 61a765b6939d
Mechanism
a percentile cluster bootstrap narrows by (n-1)/n and uses z where t belongs, so it under-covers at small cluster counts; src/sideband/stats.py called it "the conservative end" (relative to Clopper-Pearson), and no document disclosed the shortfall at the record's cluster counts. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:75 · 61a765b6939d
Measured cost
coverage 0.897 / 0.939 / 0.948 at 10 / 30 / 60 clusters for a nominal 0.95 on an F-24-shaped paired simulation of paired_cluster_delta_ci (docs/audits/2026-10-15-image-audit/coverage_out.json). The nearest label-deciding bound to the +0.005 floor is F-28's RN at L1 replication gate upper +0.004951 (results/real/readers_s3_r.json), which a t-for-z correction carries to +0.005026: under that correction the cell would read NOT-SHOWN instead of ABSORBED by the frozen rule, while the registered estimator is the percentile bootstrap, the label stands as registered, and the final S3 word K-2-ISOLATED does not change (F-28's dated note). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:79 · 61a765b6939d
Rule
METHOD states the coverage of the interval method at the cluster count in use before the first landing that uses it; a new instrument at thirty clusters uses a t-multiplier or a bias-corrected bootstrap and says which. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:87 · 61a765b6939d
Not yet followed by
every landed interval, by construction; the record discloses the one cell the correction would move and leaves the labels as registered. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:90 · 61a765b6939d

Cites F-24, F-28, K-2

5. A sign sentence from one seed

sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:93 · 61a765b6939d
Mechanism
the synthetic experiments ran one seed per curve (e04: seed 200), and F-4 wrote "net harmful at every offset" from that curve at rho 0.6. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:95 · 61a765b6939d
Measured cost
over seeds 200 to 209 the offset-1 value is +0.0005 on average (SE 0.0010), negative on 5 of 10, with the committed seed the most negative of the ten; offsets 2 to 6 are negative on all ten, so the rule of thumb stands and one committed clause does not (docs/audits/2026-10-15-image-audit/f4_seeds_out.json). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:97 · 61a765b6939d
Rule
a sign sentence is written only after the seeds that could overturn it have run; a curve from one seed is labelled as one seed in the finding's regime line (F-4's regime line carries that clause since 2026-10-16; F-3 and F-5 are one-seed curves too). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:101 · 61a765b6939d

6. A ledger that omits a term that differs between arms

sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:105 · 61a765b6939d
Mechanism
F-9's bit ledger priced corrections and hints but not the bonus token the verifier emits when a whole block is accepted, and the omission was not listed among the ledger's caveats; the bonus rate differs between arms, so the omission favours the arm it was meant to judge. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:107 · 61a765b6939d
Measured cost
with the bonus term priced the dense hint's break-even budget of 0.162 bits per token is about 26% high and the loss ratio reads about 26:1 instead of 20:1; the direction holds (docs/audits/2026-10-15-image-audit/e07_ledger_out.json). sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:111 · 61a765b6939d
Rule
a ledger lists every term it omits and says whether each is arm-invariant; a term that is not arm-invariant is priced or no budget number is stated. sideband/docs/LESSONS.md:115 · 61a765b6939d

Mechanism
two of the record's largest turns were arguable before any run. OQ-16's reconstruction target is the lm_head input, so the softmax-bottleneck identity settles it (F-23's dated note of 2026-10-18); and the first free baseline left token ids out while, at S3, the published analyses of MoE routing say routing follows token identity (F-24's dated note of the same day: consistent with the absorption measured, not a prediction of it, since the re-test added token ids and the standardized state in one arm). Measured cost
the OQ-16 lane through its Stage R run and Stage A freeze (F-22, F-23); the existence claims F-15 and F-17 and their re-tests F-24, F-25, F-28 and F-29, at readers below the practice the probing references describe (untuned, where Pimentel et al. ask for the highest-performing probe available; scored on top-1 accuracy; on raw inputs at F-15 and F-17). Counted in registered stages and findings, not hours: two stages of OQ-16 and four re-test findings. The cold read of 2026-10-18 (five reviewers briefed without the record's conclusions; docs/PUBLIC_CUT_PLAN.md 15.8) named both.
